thread:
Marta: Quick accessibility review of the Alerts panel copy + interactions. Noted a few things: small helper copy under toggles is only 11px and low contrast; toggle controls don't expose aria-labels; keyboard focus jumps from header to first alert card skipping filter controls. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/figma/jkl012
Evan: Good catch. Which theme/browser? I checked in light theme Chrome, same behavior.
Marta: Light + dark both. Helper copy is #7a7a7a on white; fails contrast for small text.
Priya: a11y-bot scan?
a11y-bot: Scan 1779991250: issues found: color-contrast (helper-copy 3.0:1), focus-visible (filter toggle lacks visible focus), aria (toggle lacks aria-label, alert counts not announced). See /audits/1779991250.
Evan: Quick fixes: bump helper copy to 12px and use #2b2b2b; add aria-label to toggles and aria-live region for alert counts. Also restore :focus-visible on filter controls.
Marta: For screen reader semantics, suggest toggles be <button aria-pressed="true|false" aria-label="Show only critical alerts"> rather than input alone. Also ensure alert card headings use <h3> so SRs can navigate by headings.
Priya: And for keyboard order, place filter toolbar before the list in DOM so tabbing reaches them first. Avoid tabindex fiddling where possible.
Evan: I'll open RDW-9001 with the fixes: copy size + color, aria-labels for toggles, aria-live for counts, DOM reorder, and a brief VoiceOver/NVDA smoke test. Assigning to @Evan.
Marta: Can someone run quick SR smoke after merge? 5 mins.
Priya: I can do NVDA. Marta will do VoiceOver.
Evan: Plan: small CSS + semantic changes, unit test for aria attributes, feature-flagged deploy to staging. Will ping when ready.
Marta: Thanks, keeping this blocking for the Alerts patch release until RDW-9001 merged. :thumbsup:
